scope: Source-grounded proposals for the three existing T01 cases only. No runtime execution or inventory mutation.
shared_safety_precondition: Use a dedicated test OS account or test machine whose system clipboard is disposable. A disposable Chrome profile does not isolate the OS clipboard, which is shared across profiles and applications.

Do not inspect, copy, screenshot, or record the clipboard before starting. The positive setup overwrites it with the exact owned synthetic string below. Do not run these procedures in a user's ordinary OS session.

Use the already installed/available development extension artifact. Reload that existing artifact and confirm its extension identity matches the known development build before use; do not build, package, install, or change identity for this procedure. If there is no known existing development artifact, leave runtime unverified.

If no dedicated disposable OS clipboard is available, do not execute the positive case: there is no safe way to test these system clipboard handlers without changing shared OS state. Report this fixture constraint; do not treat a Chrome profile as isolation.

manual_runner.path: Tools > Catalog; select All handlers, search/open the exact handler, enter JSON in Test runner, press Run.
manual_runner.semantics: The runner parses JSON, safe-parses the local schema, then calls handler.run directly with permissionMode=act and assignedTabId=null. It bypasses dispatcher approval and role enforcement. Handler execution here does not prove dispatcher behavior, approval/denial behavior, role denial, or live tool binding.
manual_runner.expected_target: Focus an ordinary public HTTPS page in the test Chrome window before Run. The manual context resolves the currently focused tab for these handlers; do not focus an extension page or a page where clipboard access is inappropriate.

Expect {"ok":true}; this does not restore a previous clipboard value. If cleanup cannot be confirmed, stop using that test OS account/machine and report the disposable clipboard as not cleared.

procedures.current_controls_and_modes: No inventory controls or modes changed. Run with the existing signed-in profile and current settings; do not assume admin or impersonate another role.

procedures.fixture: Requires the shared disposable OS clipboard fixture. First run set_clipboard with {"text":"MATRIX_CLIPBOARD_TEST_20261007_A"} and require {"ok":true}; do not use or record whatever was present before setup.
positive_steps: Satisfy shared_safety_precondition, complete set_clipboard fixture setup, focus the ordinary public HTTPS page, and open Tools > Catalog > All handlers > get_clipboard.

If the extension reports clipboardRead unavailable, stop and grant only the clipboardRead optional permission through the extension's existing Settings UI in the disposable test profile. Do not assume the permission is present or test denial through this manual runner.

Expect ok=true, text exactly MATRIX_CLIPBOARD_TEST_20261007_A, byte_length equal to the UTF-8 byte count of that synthetic ASCII string, and truncated=false. This asserts only the owned fixture value.
procedures.cleanup: Clear only the dedicated disposable OS clipboard with set_clipboard {"text":""}; do not call get_clipboard to check cleanup because that would read system clipboard contents. Confirm cleanup from set_clipboard's {"ok":true} result; no prior value is restored.

procedures.name: clipboard
procedures.current_controls_and_modes: No inventory controls or modes changed. Handler reports read tier for action=read and action tier for action=write; run with the existing signed-in profile and current settings, without assuming admin or impersonating another role.

procedures.fixture: Requires the shared disposable OS clipboard fixture. Use only the synthetic string MATRIX_CLIPBOARD_TEST_20261007_A and never inspect or record pre-test clipboard content.
positive_steps: Satisfy shared_safety_precondition, focus the ordinary public HTTPS test page, and open Tools > Catalog > All handlers > clipboard.
Write case: enter exactly {"action":"write","text":"MATRIX_CLIPBOARD_TEST_20261007_A"}; click Run and expect {"ok":true}.
Read case: enter exactly {"action":"read"}; click Run and expect {"ok":true,"text":"MATRIX_CLIPBOARD_TEST_20261007_A"}.
Clear the synthetic fixture after this case using set_clipboard {"text":""} and expect {"ok":true}; this clears the test value but does not restore a prior value.

invalid_cases.expected: Schema mismatch before handler.run because action is outside read/write.
Schema-valid; handler returns {"ok":false,"reason":"text required for action='write'"} without writing.

procedures.cleanup: If the positive write succeeded but a later step failed, clear the synthetic fixture with set_clipboard {"text":""} on the dedicated disposable OS clipboard. Do not attempt to restore unknown pre-test content.

limits: All runtime observations remain unverified; these are proposed source-derived procedures only.

A browser profile does not isolate the system clipboard. Safe positive execution requires a disposable OS-level clipboard context; if unavailable, the precise unresolved fixture constraint is that clipboard read/write inherently observes or changes shared OS clipboard state.
Manual Tools runner results do not establish dispatcher permission prompts, Ask/Act approval or denial, member/admin authorization, or live database binding.
